parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: DiskId
parameters.description:
The ID of a disk for which you want to create a snapshot-consistent group. You can specify disk IDs across instances within the same zone. Valid values of N: 1 to 128. A snapshot-consistent group can contain up to 128 disks with a total capacity of no more than 256 TiB.

Take note of the following items:

- This parameter cannot be specified together with `ExcludeDiskId.N`.
- If you specify `InstanceId`, this parameter can only be set to disks attached to the specified instance and no longer supports specifying disk IDs across multiple instances.

parameters.name: ExcludeDiskId
parameters.description:
The ID of a disk in the instance for which you do not want to create a snapshot. After you specify this parameter, the snapshot-consistent group does not contain the snapshot of the specified disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 128.

Default value: null, which indicates that snapshots are created for all disks in the instance.

> This parameter cannot be specified together with `DiskId.N`.

parameters.name: InstantAccess
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable snapshot instant access. Valid values:

- true: enables snapshot instant access.
- false: disables snapshot instant access.

Default value: false.

>**[Deprecated]** Standard snapshots of enterprise SSDs have been upgraded to [instant access by default](~~193667~~). No additional configuration or fees are required. You do not need to set this parameter.

parameters.name: InstantAccessRetentionDays
parameters.description:
Settings the number of days for which the snapshot instant access feature is active. Unit: days. Valid values: 1 to 65535.

This parameter takes effect only when `InstantAccess=true`. The snapshot instant access feature is automatically disabled when the specified duration expires.

Default value: null, which indicates that the duration is the same as the snapshot release period.

>**[Deprecated]** Standard snapshots of enterprise SSDs have been upgraded to [instant access by default](~~193667~~). No additional configuration or fees are required. You do not need to set this parameter.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the snapshot-consistent group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and colons (:).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the snapshot-consistent group belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the snapshot-consistent group. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the snapshot-consistent group. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
